objective: Express the co-op's outdoor purpose by closing on Black Friday.
businessContext: A retailer chose to close stores and delay order processing during a major shopping day.
strategy: Turn a costly operational choice into credible proof of values and invite community participation.
outcomes: REI made the closure a permanent employee benefit after running the platform since 2015.
whatWorked: The message was backed by a visible operational sacrifice.
whatFailed: The available source does not establish incremental sales or brand lift.
transferConditions: The organization can make a durable operational commitment consistent with its member promise.
nonTransferConditions: Do not borrow anti-consumption messaging without accepting a real business trade-off.

sources.title: REI makes Opt Outside permanent
sources.methodology: Confirms history, operational behavior and permanence; does not isolate commercial effect.
